narrative: Two signals push on the long-context-local-default convergence: Nvidia posted Nemotron 3 Ultra with a 1M-token context and an NVFP4 quantized build, and the Dev Box runs 120B-plus models at 1M context locally. A long-context open model serving on hardware a developer owns is the direction the recipe points, reinforcing the local-inference floor.
remaining_gap: Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B mixture-of-experts design, not 27B dense; no third-vendor 20-30B dense release confirms convergence on the specific recipe.
